description: A.M.S. Fernando v. S.A.N.K. Appuhamy A.M.S. Fernando v. S.A.N.K. Appuhamy View More before Hon. Eric Basnayake, J.
parties: A.M.S. Fernando v. S.A.N.K. Appuhamy A.M.S. Fernando v. S.A.N.K. Appuhamy View More
keywords: The Petitioner appealed against an order granting the defendant unconditional leave to defend a summary procedure action on a dishonoured cheque without furnishing security. The defendant alleged the cheque was a blank security cheque issued in connection with a seettu transaction and that no consideration passed. Held - the defence was prima facie sustainable and raised facts requiring the Petitioner to prove consideration under Sections 704(2) and 706 of the Civil Procedure Code. Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
